versions.subject: Detecting Code injection with PowerShell in another process
Clean-up service: sysmon as it will be replaced by filling the category
fix: FPs noticed with Aurora
versions.detection:
selection:
    SourceImage|endswith:
        - '\powershell.exe'
        - '\pwsh.exe'
filter_powershell:
    SourceParentImage: 'C:\Windows\System32\CompatTelRunner.exe'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter*
